mapper.insert: INSERT INTO wechat_event ( app_id, open_id, event_type, raw_msg_type, raw_event, message_id, original_occurred_at, effective_occurred_at, received_at, anomalous_timestamp, deduplication_key, raw_event_key, qr_scene, ticket, ticket_present, menu_key, menu_url, latitude, longitude, location_precision, composite_type, composite_item_count, composite_sha256, safe_summary, normalized_message_sha256 ) VALUES ( #{appId}, #{openId}, #{eventType}, #{rawMsgType}, #{rawEvent,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{messageId,jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{originalOccurredAt}, #{effectiveOccurredAt}, #{receivedAt}, #{anomalousTimestamp}, #{deduplicationKey}, #{rawEventKey,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{qrScene,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{ticket,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{ticketPresent}, #{menuKey,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{menuUrl,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{latitude,jdbcType=DECIMAL}, #{longitude,jdbcType=DECIMAL}, #{locationPrecision,jdbcType=DECIMAL}, #{compositeType,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{compositeItemCount,jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{compositeSha256,jdbcType=CHAR}, #{safeSummary}::jsonb, #{normalizedMessageSha256} )
mapper.select: SELECT id, app_id, open_id, event_type, raw_msg_type, raw_event, message_id, original_occurred_at, effective_occurred_at, received_at, anomalous_timestamp, deduplication_key, raw_event_key, qr_scene, ticket, ticket_present, menu_key, menu_url, latitude, longitude, location_precision, composite_type, composite_item_count, composite_sha256, safe_summary, normalized_message_sha256, created_at FROM wechat_event WHERE app_id = #{appId} AND deduplication_key = #{deduplicationKey}
